subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed minimal fix was not implemented. The file exports a bare `createContext` with no Provider component, no `useState`, no `useEffect`, and no `onEntryChange` subscription. The `useContent` hook (consumed by 236+ components) calls `useContext(ContentstackContext)` and will always return the static SSR-provided default content. No reactive state mechanism exists to propagate live preview updates to any consumer.
issues.suggestedFix: Create a `ContentstackProvider` component that uses `useState` (initialized with `defaultContent`) and a `useEffect` that calls `LivePreview.onEntryChange()` (from `@contentstack/live-preview-utils`) to merge incoming CMS edits into state. Wrap the `ContentstackContext.Provider` value with this state so all consumers re-render on entry changes.

issues.description: The `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` dependency is not installed anywhere in the project (no reference in package.json or src/). Without this SDK, no client-side WebSocket-based Live Preview subscription can be established, making real-time content updates impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` to package.json dependencies and install it. Import `LivePreview` from this package in the Provider component to subscribe to `onEntryChange` events.

issues.description: `useContent` calls `useContext(ContentstackContext)` but there is no reactive Provider component supplying a changing value. The hook will always return a static value and cannot propagate live preview updates to the 236+ consumers. Even if Contentstack live preview events fired, there is no state setter to trigger re-renders.
issues.suggestedFix: Once the ContentstackProvider is created with useState + onEntryChange, the hook will automatically benefit from the reactive context value. No change needed to the hook itself, but it is blocked on the Provider being implemented.

issues.description: No `live_preview` field was added to the Contentstack query/entry config interfaces (ICreateQueryConfig, ICreateEntryConfig). The prescribed fix requires adding optional `live_preview` fields so live preview hash data can flow through to Contentstack queries. Without it, queries will always return published content.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview?: Record<string, string>;` to `ICreateQueryConfig` and `ICreateEntryConfig` interfaces in the Contentstack service interface file.

issues.description: `createContentTypeQuery` and `createContentTypeEntryQuery` do not call `query.includeFallback()` or pass `live_preview` context to the Contentstack query chain. The Stack `options` object does not include a `live_preview` config block (management_token, host, enable). Even if the SDK were configured, queries will always return published content because the live_preview hash from URL params is never forwarded.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a `live_preview: { management_token, host, enable: true }` block to the Stack options. In `createContentTypeQuery`/`createContentTypeEntryQuery`, check for a `live_preview` config field and call `query.includeFallback()` and pass the live_preview hash so draft content is returned during preview sessions.

issues.description: `getStaticProps` does not forward `context.preview` or `context.previewData` (or a `live_preview` URL param) to Contentstack service calls. No `pages/api/preview.ts` route exists to enable Next.js draft mode. Even if the service layer supported `live_preview`, draft content would never be fetched because the page-level code doesn't pass preview context through.
issues.suggestedFix: In `getStaticProps`, check `context.preview` and extract `live_preview` hash from `context.previewData` or URL query params, then pass it through to all Contentstack service calls. Create a `pages/api/preview.ts` route that calls `setPreviewData` to enable Next.js draft mode.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests exist for the Live Preview feature. There are no tests mirroring src/context/ for a ContentstackProvider, no tests for live_preview config in Stack options, no tests for includeFallback() behavior, and no tests verifying reactive content updates via onEntryChange. The test count has not increased to cover this new feature.
issues.suggestedFix: Add vitest unit tests under test/unit/ mirroring src/context/ that verify: (1) the Provider initializes with defaultContent, (2) onEntryChange callback updates content state, (3) consumers receive updated content, (4) live_preview config is correctly passed to Stack options, and (5) includeFallback is called when live_preview is present.
